content: केशः [क्लिश्यते क्लिश्नाति वा क्लिश्-अन् लो लोपश्च <ls>Uṇ. 5. 33</ls>] .²1 Hair in general; विकीर्णकेशासु परेतभूमिषु <ls>Ku. 5. 68</ls>. .²2 Especially, the hair of the head; केशेषु गृहीत्वा or केशग्राहं युध्यन्ते <ls>Sk.</ls>; मुक्तकेशा <ls>Ms. 7. 91</ls>; केशव्यपरोपणादिव <ls>R. 3. 56</ls>, <ls n="R.">2. 8</ls>. .²3 The mane of a horse or lion. .²4 A ray of light. .²5 An epithet of Varuṇa. .²6 A kind of perfume. .²7 An epithet of Viṣṇu. .{@-शी@} .²1 A lock of hair (on the crown of the head.) .²2 An epithet of Durgā.
